schools.mascot: Henderson Warriors · East Vikings · Rustin Golden Knights
schools.note: Three high schools share the district. West Chester University athletics run on a separate calendar and draw big fall crowds downtown.

facts.title: The county seat since 1786
facts.text: West Chester became Chester County's seat when the courts moved from Chester city. The Greek Revival courthouse on High Street still anchors the grid.

facts.title: An unusually intact downtown
facts.text: The borough holds one of the larger concentrations of 19th-century architecture in the region, much of it never demolished — which is why the whole downtown reads as a piece.

facts.title: The university shapes the calendar
facts.text: West Chester University's term dates move the town's rhythm: parking, restaurant waits and event attendance all shift when roughly 17,000 students arrive and leave.

facts.title: Horticultural country
facts.text: Longwood Gardens, Chester County's marquee attraction, sits about twenty minutes south in Kennett Square. Its seasonal displays pull regional traffic through the area year-round.
